title: Language
description: Language information including ISO codes, native names, language family, speaker count, and countries where spoken. Used for internationalization, language databases, and localization systems.

id.description: Unique identifier for the language record

name.description: English name of the language (e.g., English, Spanish, French)

native_name.description: Name of the language in its native script (e.g., Español, Français, 中文)

code.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., en, es, fr, zh)

code3.description: ISO 639-2 three-letter language code (e.g., eng, spa, fra, zho)

family.description: Language family or group (e.g., Indo-European, Sino-Tibetan, Afro-Asiatic)

speakers.description: Estimated number of native speakers worldwide

countries.description: Array of country names where this language is spoken
